Please add an option to add photos to entries, so we can save receipts and proof of payments. It would be nice to add more number number of free categories, it's still very basic. There is a bug in the initial key, when you delete a category you cannot add another in its place. Is there an option to disable the "total balance" display? It is very confusing since the money spent and collected during the month is not only reflected in purchases, I just want to know about this month specifically.
